messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need concrete owners and timelines for customer comms and RCA access. Who will own statuspage language and the 72h public summary?

maria: I can own the statuspage copy. Draft suggestion: 'We experienced an incident causing increased inference latency for a subset of requests. Services have been stabilized; investigation ongoing. Customers impacted will be contacted with next steps.' Keep it short and non-technical. :white_check_mark:

liz: Short copy works. A couple points: 1) prepare an internal 72h summary for account teams (more detail) and a separate customer-facing 72h note. 2) define policy for sharing full RCAs vs private/redacted ones.

jordan: Proposed timing: 72h internal + customer summaries, RCA draft in 7 business days, public RCA in 14 calendar days unless legal/third-party redaction required. If a customer needs earlier access, we provide a redacted private RCA after legal review.

alex: Sounds good. Please put owners and ETAs here so we can track. Also flagging a recurring pattern: this is the 3rd similar latency incident in ~8 weeks. Need a mitigation owner for recurring incidents.

maria: Action items:
- Statuspage copy + publish 5 owner: maria 5 ETA: +1h
- 72h internal + customer summary 5 owner: jordan 5 ETA: +72h
- Full RCA draft 5 owner: liz 5 ETA: +7d
- Recurring-incident mitigation plan & owner 5 owner: alex 5 ETA: +14d

liz: Legal note: any RCA that mentions vendor behavior or contains customer logs requires legal review. Looping in @sam for turnaround times.

sam: I can do redaction review on the 72h draft within 24h; full RCA review may take up to 3 business days depending on scope. Tag requests with 'legal-review' in the tracker and cc legal@redwood.

ops-bot: Action created: INC-5312 | owner:maria | due: +1h
ops-bot: Action created: INC-5313 | owner:jordan | due: +72h
ops-bot: Action created: INC-5314 | owner:liz | due: +7d
ops-bot: Action created: INC-5315 | owner:alex | due: +14d

maria: Drafted statuspage posted in #incidents-drafts: https://go/internal/statuspage-draft — please comment inline. Will not publish until legal confirms wording for impacted-customer sentence.
jordan: For the 72h customer note I'll prepare two templates: (A) short email for self-serve users, (B) tailored account note for enterprises. Both will list affected endpoints and remediation steps but omit raw logs.
liz: Add an FAQ bullet to the statuspage: 'How can I request a detailed RCA for my account?' Suggested: 'Open a support ticket and choose "Incident RCA"; we'll respond within 3 business days.'
alex: Good. I'll spin up a small working group (SRE + runtime + ML infra) to propose recurring-incident mitigations (KV cache tuning, routing fallbacks, batch-size caps). Those action items will be added under INC-5315.
maria: Once legal signs off I'll publish the statuspage update and post the 72h customer note to the incident doc.
sam: Please cc legal@redwood when you post the draft so I get notified.
jordan: Noted. I'll upload the 72h docs to the incident folder and ping owners when ready.
alex: Thanks everyone 5 recording these owners in the postmortem tracker. If you need to reassign, update the INC tickets rather than replying here. :thumbsup:
